label: Grok geometry — capybara bot head
revised_prompt: Official product app-icon logo mark in the design philosophy of xAI Grok: extreme geometric simplification, high-contrast two-tone, almost-abstract mascot that still reads instantly. A capybara head reduced to a few perfect curves and one or two negative-space cuts: blunt rounded snout, tiny half-circle ears, calm slit or oval eye, stout cheeks. Looks like a smart calm companion bot, not a cartoon, not a 3D character, not a plush toy. Flat vector, deep navy (#0B1F3A) on pure white. Centered square composition with padding. No text, no letters, no Grok logo copy, no X logo, no photorealism, no fur, no gradient, no 3D bevel. Tech-oriented, modern, friendly but restrained. Ultra high resolution.
